description: The state and result of an audit started with run_audit: running, complete, unknown (the count could not be made; never reported as zero) or failed. Show a complete result as run_audit says: result.summary, the counts by category as a table, and result.next_step when it is not null, with any plans in it as a table of plan, price and when it costs less.
name: get_audit_result
title: Get an audit's result
